review_evidence: Complete unit inventory covers 555 files: 535 language-specific Linglib/Fragments modules and 20 Linglib/Processing modules; every file owns declarations and 329 files contain 1,839 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.

The fragments are typed lexical/grammatical resources across many languages rather than disposable examples; direct inspection of Fragments/English/Pronouns.lean shows feature-rich pronoun entries plus checked classification properties.
The Processing modules formalize parsing, memory, psychophysics, signal detection and related computational/cognitive models, so neither major subtree is build/test scaffolding.
summary: Retain the complete Linglib fragments/processing unit as reusable typed grammar data and checked processing theory.

summary: Surveyed all 499 listed files: 488 under Linglib/Fragments (per-language directories, largest Slavic 43, English 38, Romance 37, German 26, Mayan 25) and 11 under Linglib/Processing (DiscriminativeLexicon 6, Surprisal 4, other 1). Every file exists, is a .lean module, and has at least one Lean declaration; 164 files hold theorem/lemma/example proofs. Files are typed grammar fragments (paradigms, lexical entries, inventories) with decidable facts about them, and Processing files hold mathlib-based definitions and theorems. Disposition: retain all; no exclusions.

summary: Inspected 15 files spanning Fragments (Akan, Arabic, Basque, Burmese, Cantonese, Chichewa, Czech, Dutch, English, German, Hindi, Japanese, Mayan, Swahili, Turkish) and Processing (DiscriminativeLexicon, SignalDetection, Surprisal). Every file contains formal mathematical content: inductive types, structures, definitions, theorems, lemmas, and decidable examples/proofs formalizing linguistic theories (case, agreement, verbs, determiners, negation, polarity, relativization, declension, morphotactics) and mathematical models (probability, measure theory, information theory, psychophysics). No pure import aggregators, empty files, or duplicates found. Previous review also retained all files.
